question:
What breaks, or needs different handling, when the Cockpit launches sessions and reads status events on Windows?

To find out:

- How Claude Code runs on Windows today (native, WSL, Git Bash) and what that means for the `claude` command an extension spawns.
- How a VS Code terminal created by an extension passes a command with a quoted slash-command argument and environment variables across PowerShell, cmd and Git Bash.
- Whether exec-form hooks (`command: node`, `args`) and `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` paths work on Windows.
- Whether appending to and watching the events file behaves the same there.

## Context

- See [Sessions](https://github.com/dbarjs/hero-synergy/blob/main/docs/seed.md#sessions) and [Live status](https://github.com/dbarjs/hero-synergy/blob/main/docs/seed.md#live-status) in the seed.
- "Which platforms and editors does v0.1.0 support?" waits on this answer.
summary: How do VS Code terminals and Claude Code hooks behave on Windows?

resolution.author: dbarjs
resolution.gist: Research documented with specific findings on Windows behavior; identified key compatibility issues with `claude` installation method, shell quoting, and file watching; several aspects flagged for real Windows testing.
